figurative_meaning_en: purpose, search for work or livelihood
example_sentences_in_bangla: এখনো কোনো ভালো কাজের ধান্ধায় আছি।
তার ধান্ধা শেষ হলে সব ঠিক হয়ে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: I'm still in search of a good job.
Once his quest for work ends, everything will be fine.
note: This idiom reflects the common struggle for employment in Bengali-speaking regions, influenced by everyday socio-economic challenges.
